correctness.rationale: For common iid continuous effective cutpoints, sorting them leaves iid Bernoulli preference signs; at gap j exactly U_n-S_j voters reject. A cutpoint itself offers no smaller count because only one acceptance condition changes with equality, hence optimal V_n=U_n-M_n where M_n=max_{0<=j<=n} S_j. Conditioned on U_n=u, reflection at level u-k+1 leaves binom(n,u)-binom(n,k-1) valid paths, giving exact distribution-free tail. V_n=0 exactly for a +block followed by a -block. Negative-drift random-walk maximum has geometric hitting probabilities, giving mean correction min(p,q)/abs(p-q) and binomial CLT. For p=1/2 the reflection identity E M_n=E abs(S_n)-P(S_n>0) yields n/2-sqrt(2n/pi)+1/2+o(1), and Donsker plus continuous supremum mapping yields both Brownian maxima and p_n=1/2+theta/sqrt n drift. Independent direct enumeration all sign words n=1..10 for p=.25,.50,.75 checked every k-tail and feasibility formula.
